metadata.question: In 2003, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Queensland, Australia record a higher maximum daytime land surface temperature compared to Lut Desert, Iran and El Azizia, Libya?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Terra daily LST product MODIS/061/MOD11A1 for 2003-01-01 to 2004-01-01. Regions: Queensland (GAUL Admin1), Lut Desert (a focused rectangle in Dasht-e Lut, Iran), and El Azizia, Libya (rectangle around the town). If the primary collection is empty, fallback to MODIS/006/MOD11A1.
2. Masking strategy: Use QC_Day bits 0–1 < 2 (keep “good” and “other quality”) to mask invalid/cloud-affected pixels. Convert LST_Day_1km to Kelvin by multiplying 0.02.
3. Logic: For each region, compute valid pixel counts (total vs valid), and the maximum LST (K and C). If collection empty -> C1. If valid pixels = 0 in any region -> C2. If max is null/invalid -> C3. Otherwise, if Queensland’s max > both others -> A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2003-01-01';
    const end = '2004-01-01';

    // Queensland (GAUL Admin1)
    const gaul1 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const qld = gaul1
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Australia'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Queensland'))
      .geometry();

    // Lut Desert, Iran (Dasht-e Lut hot core region)
    const lut = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([58.0, 30.0, 59.5, 31.0], null, false);

    // El Azizia, Libya
    const elAzizia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([12.6, 32.2, 13.4, 33.0], null, false);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    function getCol(dataset) {
      return ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']);
    }
    let dataset = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A1';
    let col = getCol(dataset);
    let size = await col.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`Primary ${dataset} images: ${size}`);
    if (size === 0) {
      // Fallback
      dataset = 'MODIS/006/MOD11A1';
      col = getCol(dataset);
      size = await col.size().getInfo();
      console.log(`Fallback ${dataset} images: ${size}`);
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log('No images found in 2003 for both datasets.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing: Masking with QC and scaling to Kelvin
    const maskDay = function (img) {
      const qa = img.select('QC_Day');
      const good = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // bits 0-1 < 2 -> Good/Other quality
      const lstK = img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(good).multiply(0.02);
      return lstK.rename('LST_K').copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    };
    const colMasked = col.map(maskDay);

    // Max per-pixel across the year
    const maxLST = colMasked.max(); // band 'LST_K'

    // Helper to compute stats for a region
    async function regionStats(geom, name) {
      const totalCount = await ee.Image(1).rename('LST_K').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e10,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('LST_K').getInfo();

      const validCount = await maxLST.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e10,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('LST_K').getInfo();

      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        return { name, totalCount: totalCount || 0, validCount: 0, maxK: null, maxC: null };
      }

      const maxK = await maxLST.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e10,
        tileScale: 4
      }).get('LST_K').getInfo();

      const maxC = (maxK !== null) ? (maxK - 273.15) : null;
      return { name, totalCount, validCount, maxK, maxC };
    }

    const qStats = await regionStats(qld, 'Queensland');
    const lStats = await regionStats(lut, 'Lut Desert');
    const eStats = await regionStats(elAzizia, 'El Azizia');

    // 4. Validation for C2/C3
    if (qStats.validCount === 0 || lStats.validCount === 0 || eStats.validCount === 0) {
      console.log('Valid pixels after masking -> Queensland:', qStats.validCount, 'Lut:', lStats.validCount, 'ElAzizia:', eStats.validCount);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    const vals = [qStats.maxC, lStats.maxC, eStats.maxC];
    if (vals.some(v => v === null || isNaN(v) || v < -100 || v > 120)) {
      console.log('Calculation invalid values:', vals);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Print concise evidence
    const pct = (v, t) => (t && t > 0) ? (100 * v / t) : 0;
    console.log(`Dataset used: ${dataset} (2003)`);
    console.log(`Queensland: total px @1km=${qStats.totalCount}, valid=${qStats.validCount} (${pct(qStats.validCount, qStats.totalCount).toFixed(1)}%), Max LST: ${qStats.maxK.toFixed(2)} K (${qStats.maxC.toFixed(2)} °C)`);
    console.log(`Lut Desert: total px @1km=${lStats.totalCount}, valid=${lStats.validCount} (${pct(lStats.validCount, lStats.totalCount).toFixed(1)}%), Max LST: ${lStats.maxK.toFixed(2)} K (${lStats.maxC.toFixed(2)} °C)`);
    console.log(`El Azizia: total px @1km=${eStats.totalCount}, valid=${eStats.validCount} (${pct(eStats.validCount, eStats.totalCount).toFixed(1)}%), Max LST: ${eStats.maxK.toFixed(2)} K (${eStats.maxC.toFixed(2)} °C)`);

    // 6. Final decision: Is Queensland > both others?
    const qHigher = (qStats.maxC > lStats.maxC) && (qStats.maxC > eStats.maxC);
    console.log(`QLD higher than both? ${qHigher ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);

    // 7. Print final tag
    console.log(qHigher ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
